answer_text:
Here is a roundup of some of the **best stocks to buy now in June 2026**, according to top analysts and financial outlets:

---

## 📈 Top Stocks to Buy – June 2026

### 1. 🚗 **Uber (UBER)**
Uber continues to benefit from steady demand in both ride-hailing and delivery. DA Davidson analyst Tom White maintained a Buy rating and $107 price target on Uber stock. Analysts have a **Strong Buy** consensus rating on Uber stock based on 27 Buys and two Holds, with an average price target of $105.96, implying **43% upside potential**.

---

### 2. ⚡ **Vistra Corp. (VST)**
Vistra is a major U.S. power producer benefiting from rising electricity demand tied to data centers, AI, and electrification, and has been expanding its clean energy and battery storage assets. Jefferies analyst Julien Dumoulin Smith reiterated a Buy rating and $212 price target, saying the stock "looks cheap after a 35% drop since late 2025."

---

### 3. ✈️ **Vertical Aerospace (EVTL)**
Vertical Aerospace is working on its VX4 aircraft, which aims to offer quiet, zero-emission urban flights, and is making progress on testing, certification, and partnerships. Analysts believe EVTL offers long-term upside if electric aviation scales the way many expect. EVTL stock has a **Strong Buy** consensus rating based on four Buys, with an average price target implying upside potential of over **350%**.

---

### 4. 🛒 **MercadoLibre (MELI)**
MercadoLibre, often referred to as the "Amazon of Latin America," operates an e-commerce marketplace with a dominant presence in some of the region's most populous nations, including Brazil and Argentina. The marketplace saw $19 billion in merchandise volume in Q1 2026, up 42% year-over-year, while Mercado Pago processes nearly $350 billion in annualized payment volume.

---

### 5. 🏠 **Airbnb (ABNB)**
In Q1 2026, more than 156 million nights and experiences were booked on Airbnb's platform, with a total booking value of over $29 billion — 19% year-over-year growth. Airbnb is not only massive and growing quickly, but also highly profitable, generating $4.5 billion in free cash flow with a 36% FCF margin over the past 12 months.

---

### 6. 🔬 **Vishay Precision Group (VPG)**
Vishay Precision Group's precision measurement and sensing technologies business is booming as it rides long-term megatrends across semiconductor equipment, data centers, avionics, military and space. Its first-quarter bookings jumped **25.5% sequentially** to $102.1 million, marking the third-highest quarterly level in VPG's history, and it is projected to grow adjusted earnings by **100%** in 2026.

---

## ⚠️ Important Disclaimer
The stock market has been volatile in 2026 due to the Iran conflict, tariff uncertainty, and fears of a weakening economy, although the S&P 500 is near an all-time high and many stocks look attractive for long-term investors.

> **This is not financial advice.** Always do your own research and consider consulting a licensed financial advisor before making investment decisions. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
